units.source_text: 滑雪季节前的温泉客栈，是顾客最少的时候，岛村从室内温泉上来，已是万籁俱寂了。

en.t: Before ski season, the hot spring inn had the fewest guests; when Shimamura came up from the indoor bath, everything had already fallen utterly silent.

units.source_text: 他在破旧的走廊上，每踏一步，都震得玻璃门微微作响。

en.t: As he walked along the shabby corridor, each step made the glass doors tremble and faintly rattle.

units.source_text: 在长廊尽头帐房的拐角处，婷婷玉立地站着一个女子，她的衣服下摆铺展在乌亮的地板上，使人有一种冷冰冰的感觉。

en.t: At the bend by the office at the end of the long corridor, a woman stood slender and upright; the hem of her clothing spread over the glossy black floor, giving off a cold impression.
